name: Vierendeel frame action
definition_zh: 由梁柱框架弯矩与剪力传递形成的抗倒塌作用机制。
usage_note: 正文指出多层框架的该机制需考虑竖向弯矩分布，限制本文低层简化模型外推。
usage_overview: 用于解释柱失效后框架的荷载重分配，依靠梁柱弯曲协同及弯矩、剪力传递形成抗倒塌作用。多层框架中沿高度的弯矩分布是重要影响因素，相关低层简化模型的适用性受此限制。

complete_examples.text: For S2, the Vierendeel frame action of two-story frame beam floor system to improve the performance of RC structures against progressive collapse is not obvious.
Comparison of these experimental in-dicates that, the Vierendeel frame action to enhanced the progressive collapse capacity was not obvious.
In addi tion, the Vierendeel frame action will work as a key mechanism in the redistribution of gravity loads and provide additional resistance.
This is because the Vierendeel frame action is served as the major mechanism for redistribution of applied loads in 5-sotry frame structure.
